acceptance: A cell that reads ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml is refused by the sandbox, and the sandbox contract test is red without the fix
The console-builder persona and profile state that the cell runs no gh command
docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md states the credential path class and its stage
fix: Deny the read of credential paths (gh, git credential stores, cloud CLI configs) for every phase and console cell through the OS sandbox read rules, as I5 enforce for this path class, and keep the log for other paths. Check which tool in the cell read them (a gh command is the likely cause) and refuse gh inside a build cell.
source: console, 2026-11-11, bridge isolation signal of a console-builder run
summary: On 2026-11-11 the console-builder run agent-console-builder-20261111T045624Z-90c1 (claude-tmux, pid 32544) read ~/.config/gh/config.yml and ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml. The bridge logged ISOLATION_I5_VIOLATION with action=logged, because I5 (read isolation, ADR-0154) is not at enforce. hosts.yml holds the GitHub token, so a build cell can read a credential that no build needs. A second run, agent-console-builder-20261111T051109Z-fdc9 (pid 20074, process=gh, rule=read.home.secret), read the same two files although its brief forbade gh. Both runs read them, so a session hook, status line or tool of the claude-tmux seat likely runs gh, not the agent. Check the hooks and the status line that a cell inherits.
title: A console-builder cell read the gh credential files outside its grants (I5 is only logged)
